text:
Jen: About to start phased unpin of runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 in eu-staging. Will do 10% -> 50% -> 100% if checks pass. @deploy-bot gate on SDK compatibility please.
Owen: Reminder SDK 3.2.2 adds that header change (X-Model-Bind). We saw a fallback in hosted path last month.
Jen: Right, want to avoid regressing customers running longseq workloads.
Maria: Perf lab ran v2.15 with longseq and saw kv-cache miss rate +3%. Not a showstopper but worth keeping an eye on.
Tony: Can deploy-bot verify node SDK versions and abort if any node reports SDK < 3.2.2? Prefer abort over asymmetric routing.
deploy-bot: run-check: compatibility-check --region eu-staging --runtime v2.15 --min-sdk 3.2.2
Kira: Also add a smoke test: POST /v1/generate with ~1024-token prefix, assert p50 < 200ms and p99 < 350ms. Fail => rollback.
Owen: Adding smoke job now: ci/canary-eu-staging-smoke:add-kv-longseq (PR in 3m).
deploy-bot: compatibility-check result: 4/12 nodes report SDK 3.2.1, 8/12 report 3.2.2. Action: ABORT unpin and notify owners.
Jen: Thanks deploy-bot. We'll not proceed until all nodes are on 3.2.2.
Tony: Proposing a maintenance window tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC to roll the SDKs on the 4 nodes. If infra teams agree we can retry after.
Maria: I'll draft a short release-note for support: "staging runtime unpin delayed due to mixed SDKs; upgrade scheduled" and post to #support.
Kira: If SDK upgrades can't finish, fallback is an extended canary (24h) on the nodes that do have 3.2.2, but that introduces routing complexity. Prefer uniform SDK roll.
Owen: Smoke PR merged. CI will run once we trigger canary.
deploy-bot: abort-notice sent to #eng-releases. To retry: deploy-bot retry-unpin --thread 1761009999 after compatibility-check passes.
Jen: I'll coordinate with infra and update this thread. Leaving pinned until green. :thumbsup:
